title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: STEERING:COLUMN (5,222 affected)
summary: SOME BUSES MAY HAVE MISALIGNMENT OF THE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND THE GEAR BOX.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (106 affected)
summary: OWNER"S MANUAL FAILS TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 126, TRUCK CAMPER LOADING. CENTER OF GRAVITY LISTED BY THE MANUFACTURER IS NOT WITHIN AN ACCURACY OF 2 INCHES OF THE ACTUAL CENTER OF GRAVITY OF THE CAMPER.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (2,100 affected)
summary: THE CLAMPS ON FLEXIBLE FUEL HOSES CONNECTING THE FUEL PUMP TO THE METAL LINE MAY NOT BE IN THE PROPER POSITION.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS (1,050 affected)
summary: SOME VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED WHEELS. THE WELDS SECURING THE CENTER SECTIONS TO THE RIMS MAY CRACK FROM FATIGUE.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (18 affected)
summary: THE RATIO ADAPTER ATTACHED TO THE SPEEDOMETER AND AN AIR SWITCH, BOTH LOCATED BEHIND THE DASH, MAY COME IN CONTACT WITH A HEATER DUCT HOSE THAT IS REINFORCED WITH COILED WIRE.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:COLUMN LOCKING:ANTI-THEFT DEVICE (11,800 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL MAY BE LOCKED WHEN THE IGNITION KEY IS IN THE OFF POSITION AND THE GEAR SHIFT LEVER IS NOT IN PARK. THIS CONDITION CONSTITUTES A NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 114, THEFT PROTECTION.

title: Ford Motor Company: MANUFACTURER'S INFORMATION TO DEALERS (11,800 affected)
summary: LABELS SPECIFYING VEHICLE CAPACITY WEIGHT AND DESIGNATED SEATING CAPACITY OVERSTATE THE MAXIMUM LOAD PERMISSIBLE FOR BOTH OCCUPANTS AND LUGGAGE. THE LABEL IS IN NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110, TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS.

title: Great Dane Trailers: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (38 affected)
summary: ONE HALF INCH X 6 INCH BOTTOM FLANGES MAY CONTAIN DEFECTIVE STEEL.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:BOOSTER (1,612 affected)
summary: THE POWER BRAKE BOOSTER MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY MACHINED CAUSING STRESS AND POSSIBLY CRACKS IN THE MASTER CYLINDER WHERE IT IS ATTACHED TO THE POWER BRAKE BOOSTER.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (54,056 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION DOWNSHIFT LINKAGE ADJACENT TO THE ENGINE THROTTLE CONTROL CONTAINS A PLASTIC BUSHING THAT COULD DEFORM DUE TO HIGH ENGINE COMPARTMENT TEMPERATURES CREATED BY THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (2,500 affected)
summary: SOME HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLIES MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY REPAIRED AT THE FACTORY, OR INCORRECT FASTENERS WERE USED. HOOD LATCH ATTACHMENT WILL NOT BE STRONG ENOUGH AND WILL LIKELY WEAKEN THE INNER HOOD PANEL.

title: EMGO INTERNATIONAL LTD.: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS (16,600 affected)
summary: CANDLE POWER OF LAMPS MAY BE INADEQUATE BY AS MUCH AS 40%, THE LENS DOES NOT PRODUCE A GOOD BEAM PATTERN, BULB EYE AT THE CENTER DOES NOT HAVE ENOUGH CURVATURE TO FUNCTION AS LENS, AND LIGHT SOCKETS ARE POORLY FORMED. NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT:BEARING WHEEL (10,504 affected)
summary: POSSIBILITY THAT THE FRONT WHEEL BEARINGS DO NOT HAVE ENOUGH LUBRICATION.
